﻿# HackFinder — Hackathon Discovery & Semantic Search

AI-powered platform that aggregates hackathons from Knowafest and lets users discover them using natural language semantic search.

---

## Quick Start

### 1. Install dependencies
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
playwright install chromium
```

### 2. Set up `.env`
```
QDRANT_URL=<your-qdrant-cloud-url>
QDRANT_API_KEY=<your-qdrant-api-key>
LLM_MODEL=mistral          # optional, for Ollama
OLLAMA_URL=http://localhost:11434  # optional
```

### 3. Scrape hackathons
```bash
python -m scraper.scraper
```

### 4. Upload embeddings to Qdrant
```bash
python -m database.uploader
```

### 5. Start the API
```bash
uvicorn api.main:app --reload
```

### 6. Open the Frontend
Open `frontend/index.html` in your browser.

---

## Automated Pipeline (optional)

Run the scheduler to auto-refresh data every 12 hours:
```bash
python -m scraper.scheduler
```

---

## LLM Integration (do this last)

1. Install [Ollama](https://ollama.com/download)
2. Pull a model: `ollama pull mistral`
3. Restart uvicorn — the `/search` endpoint will now include an `llm_summary` in responses automatically.

---

## API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| `POST` | `/search` | Semantic search. Body: `{ "text": "...", "limit": 10 }` |
| `GET`  | `/events` | Browse all events. Params: `?limit=20&skip=0` |
| `GET`  | `/health` | API + Ollama status check |
| `GET`  | `/docs`   | Auto-generated Swagger UI |

---
